newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle active at $65, up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle active at $65, up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active, with slaughter steers and heifers fully $1.00 per cwt higher than last Friday, USDA said. Inquiry and demand good.

Sales confirmed on 13,900 slaughter steers and 15,200 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 33,600 head confirmed including 3,400 head or about 10 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1250 lbs, mostly 1175- 1200 lbs 65.00; few Select with end Choice 1175-1300 lbs 64.00-64.50. Dressed Basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 105.00.

Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1100 lbs 65.00; few early 64.00-64.50; few Select with end Choice 1000-1050 lbs 64.00-65.00; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1100 lb heifers and heiferettes 65.00. Dressed Basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1150 lbs 105.00-106.00.
